# Session 4: The Thornwood

The party followed a cart track into the Thornwood, where the missing fishermen were last seen. Sefa found boot prints and a trail of salt leading north.

Cultists in grey robes ambushed the party at a ruined chapel. Brother Aldric, who had followed the party to help, was killed by a cultist's spear while shielding Sefa. Dorran swore an oath to avenge Brother Aldric.

Iska searched the bodies and found a letter sealed with a wave-shaped sigil. The letter ordered the cultists to "bring the key to the lady."

## GM only

The ritual to open the sea vault is planned for the new moon. Captain Rhosyn Dace owes a gambling debt to Lady Maren Ashcombe and has been passing her information.
